errors.text_span: стойностите на показателя са изобразени като вертикални линии, свързани със стойности, изписани върху тях
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the main visual elements as "vertical lines, connected with values". The chart is a line plot where data points are connected by a dashed line, and vertical lines (stems) extend downwards from these points. The description misses the connecting dashed line entirely and misrepresents the role of the vertical lines.

The description fails to mention that the data points are connected by a dashed white line. The prompt explicitly asks for a description of the line, including its style (solid, dashed, etc.) and color.
The phrase "stronger decrease" is subjective and interpretive, which is forbidden by the prompt. A neutral description would simply state the values.

errors.text_span: стойностите се стабилизират около 33,3 през 2020 година
errors.evidence: The word "stabilize" is an interpretation of the trend. The values in the last three years are 33.7, 34.1, and 33.3, which shows fluctuation, not stabilization. A neutral description should state the values.
